title: Concept: PostgreSQL error detail disclosed in a response
description: A PostgreSQL relation-not-found error naming the missing table in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message confirms the schema name and the query shape, so an injection attempt learns which table names exist and which do not.
applicability: Deployments that render a PostgreSQL relation-not-found error naming the missing table into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message confirms the schema name and the query shape, so an injection attempt learns which table names exist and which do not.
